name: dashboard-trust-checker
description: Audits a dashboard inventory you provide (a spreadsheet or a pasted export with name, owner, last refresh, viewers and query status) and classifies each dashboard as healthy, stale, broken, unused or unknown with a proposed action (keep, fix, review, retire) and the reasons, all computed in code from the inventory's own columns. Optionally adds trust evidence from chat complaints that name a dashboard. Read-only: it never opens a BI tool, never runs a query and never deletes anything; its findings are only as good as the inventory.

skills.name: Dashboard trust audit
skills.description: Flags broken, stale and unused dashboards from an inventory table (stale after 7 days or twice the stated cadence; unused at 0 viewers), proposes fix / review / retire / keep with reasons, adds verbatim chat complaints as evidence, and lists retire candidates. Read-only.
